name: Zurich

sources.title: Zurich - Appoint, change or remove AG board members
Zurich - Appoint, change or remove GmbH managers

steps.title: Review Zurich registry instructions
steps.description: Consult the official guidance for the company's legal form and the selected change.

steps.title: Prepare personnel change application
steps.description: Prepare the Anmeldung Personalmutationen using the applicable Zurich form and authorised signatures.

steps.title: Review document formalities
steps.description: Check original signatures, certified specimen signatures and identity documentation where required.

steps.title: Select a permitted filing method
steps.description: Choose an applicable online, postal or in-person procedure and verify its document-signing requirements.

steps.title: Review AG board structure
steps.description: Check the general meeting's board election, the board's constitution and the company's articles of association.

warnings: The competent body for electing the board chair may depend on the articles of association.
If several board members are provided for, the company must designate a chair in accordance with applicable rules.

steps.title: Review GmbH management structure
steps.description: Check the members' meeting decision, management chair arrangements and signing powers.

warnings: The articles of association affect who appoints the chair of management and determines signing authority.
Where there are several managers, review the requirement to designate a chair.

steps.title: Obtain acceptance of appointment
steps.description: Review the Wahlannahmeerklärung for the newly appointed board member or manager.

steps.title: Review appointment minutes
steps.description: Check the applicable general meeting or members' meeting minutes and any additional board or management resolution.

steps.title: Verify identity documents
steps.description: Review an identity card, passport or applicable foreign national identity document for the person being registered.

steps.title: Verify certified specimen signature
steps.description: Check whether the newly registered person's specimen signature must be certified and determine the accepted certification method.

warnings: Zurich provides separate appointment templates for AG board members and GmbH managers.
Registry documents may become public. Avoid unnecessary sensitive personal information.

steps.title: Review departure documentation
steps.description: Check the general meeting or members' meeting decision for removal, or resignation evidence where applicable.

steps.title: Check removal of signing powers
steps.description: Determine whether existing registered representative authority must be cancelled or amended.

steps.title: Check continuing representation
steps.description: Verify that the company's management and representation remain legally compliant.

warnings: A resignation letter may be necessary if resignation was not recorded at the relevant corporate meeting.
Departure from office must be distinguished from the cancellation of a separate signing authority.

steps.title: Review decision on signing authority
steps.description: Check the board or management decision that supports the registration, amendment or cancellation of signing powers.

steps.title: Confirm the signing arrangement
steps.description: Verify the intended individual or collective signing authority.

steps.title: Check new signatory documents
steps.description: For newly registered signatories, verify identity documentation and a certified specimen signature where required.

warnings: Different documentation may apply to adding a new signatory versus amending or removing an existing one.
Separate Zurich instructions exist for additional authorised signatories of AG and GmbH companies.

onlineRequirements: Prepare documents in the required electronic format, including PDF/A where applicable.
Obtain qualified electronic signatures from the relevant signatories.
Use a federally recognised electronic delivery platform accepted by the registry.
Check any additional requirements for electronically certified specimen signatures.

warnings: This dataset provides preliminary workflow guidance only.
Check the latest official Zurich instructions before filing.
The required documents depend on the legal form, type of change and signing arrangements.
Commercial register supporting documents may be publicly accessible.
All documents must undergo human legal review before submission.
